adaptation.base: The original 16px stone plate supplies the bevel geometry. Actions have a bright gold rim and deep teal face. Fillers and passive states use a low-contrast slate recess.
adaptation.glyphs: AstralRecord original pixel drawings, defined in scripts/generate-gui-assets.py. No third-party logos, fonts, character art or Minecraft texture pixels are included.
adaptation.output: 32x32 RGBA PNGs. Each 16px design pixel is expanded to 2x2 with nearest-neighbor sampling; Java and Bedrock outputs are byte-identical.
adaptation.roles: Navigation uses gold, confirm uses teal, close and cancel use coral with different silhouettes, disabled uses a lock, unset uses an empty outlined diamond. Color is accompanied by shape.
adaptation.scope: GUI control sprites only. Existing equipment, item, skin and skill artwork remain their own assets.
